title: Payment at Pickup, Fleet Invoices, Late Fees and Credit Hold — Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
## Payment
Retail tiers of Service Accounts and Repair Orders pay each repair order in full at pickup by a method the tier accepts. A fleet repair order is invoiced on its line date and is due the tier's payment due days (calendar days) later.

## Retired clause
The clause under which a fleet invoice paid in full within the tier's early-payment window after its line date earned an early-payment discount of the tier's early-payment share of its customer-pay total, rounded to the cent and credited as an early-payment discount, a partial payment earning none, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for the early-payment discount.

## Late fees
- A late fee is assessed only when the handling date is later than the due date of the oldest unpaid invoice plus the tier's late fee grace days (calendar days).
- The due date is the invoice line date plus the payment due days; the grace days are added to the due date, and a late fee can be assessed from the following calendar day.
- The late fee is the tier's monthly late fee share times the past-due balance at assessment, rounded to the cent, never less than the tier's smallest late fee, and assessed at most once per calendar month.
- The dates that decide this are the invoice line dates in the account's records, read against the handling date.

**Counting (hypothetical).** On a Net 15 account with 5 grace days, an invoice dated 2 May is due 17 May; grace runs to 22 May; on 22 May no late fee may be assessed, and from 23 May one may.

## Credit hold and reinstatement
A fleet account goes on credit hold when the number of calendar days between the due date of its oldest repair order with an unpaid customer-pay balance and the handling date (0 when nothing is past due) reaches the tier's credit hold figure, or when the amount owed on the account exceeds its credit limit. While on credit hold, new repair orders are written only for payment at pickup. Where the tier requires full payment for reinstatement, a credit-hold account is reinstated only once its entire past-due balance is paid; reinstatement applies only to an account whose status is credit hold, as the account record shows.

superseded_clauses: A fleet invoice paid in full within early_pay_discount_days calendar days after its line date earns an early-payment discount of early_pay_discount_pct of its customer-pay total, rounded to the cent and credited as credit_reason early_payment_discount; a partial payment earns none.
